SELECT  
	username=username,
	invcount=sum(counter),
	SRCount=sum(srcounter),
	salevalue=sum(saleinvvalue),
	yu=sum(yu),
	discount=sum(discount),
	miscandtax=sum(misccharges) + sum(SaleTax),
	grosssale=sum(grosssale),
	salereturn=max(salereturn),
	cgs = sum(cgs)
FROM 
	(SELECT 
		UserName = users.username,  
		InvCount=  SL.saleinvcode,
		SRCount = 0,
		counter=1,
		srcounter=0,
		SaleInvValue =isnull( Round(sum (Round(((SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01))),2)) * (1 - (SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)) - SL.flatdisc + SL.misccharges,0)
							+
							/*---------Adding sales tax----------*/
							Round(
							SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
							SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * 
							(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
							ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
							(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
							(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
							SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
							,0),

							/*----------end salestax--------*/
		yu=Round(  Sum (  SD.looseqty *  SD.saleprice)    
		        -  Round(Sum (Round((  SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc) * ( SD.discperc * .01)) + ( SD.looseqty  *  SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
    		        - ( Sum(Round(  SD.looseqty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * ( SL.discperc /100))
			   + misccharges - flatdisc,0),
		
		discount= isnull(sum(SD.looseqty * SD.itemflatdisc)
 		 		 + sum(Round( (SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * SD.discperc * 0.01,2))
				 + Round(sum(Round( (SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01),2)) * SL.discperc * 0.01,2)
				 + SL.flatdisc,0),

		misccharges=SL.misccharges,

		grosssale=isnull(sum(SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice),0),

		SaleTax=Round(
			SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * 
				(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
				(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
				SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),

		salereturn=000000000.00,
		cgs = SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.AvgPrice)
	FROM  
		saleledger SL, SaleDetail SD, Users	
	WHERE  
		SL.date >= :ad_StartDate and  
		SL.date <= :ad_EndDate and   
		SL.salecatcode IN (:aa_catcode) and
		SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode and	
		SL.salesmancode = Users.usercode	
	Group by 
		users.username,
		SL.saleinvcode ,
		SL.flatdisc ,
		SL.discperc,
		SL.misccharges,
		SL.invgstperc1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		UserName = users.username,  
		InvCount=  SL.saleinvcode,
		SRCount = 0,
		counter=1,
		srcounter=0,
		SaleInvValue =isnull( Round(sum (Round(((SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01))),2)) * (1 - (SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)) - SL.flatdisc + SL.misccharges,0)
			+
			/*---------Adding sales tax----------*/
			Round(
			SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * 
			(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
			(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
			SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
			,0),
			/*----------end salestax--------*/
		yu=Round(  Sum (  SD.looseqty *  SD.saleprice)    
			-  Round(Sum (Round((  SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc) * ( SD.discperc * .01)) + ( SD.looseqty  *  SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
			- ( Sum(Round(  SD.looseqty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * ( SL.discperc /100))
			+ misccharges - flatdisc,0),
		discount= isnull(sum(SD.looseqty * SD.itemflatdisc)
			+ sum(Round( (SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * SD.discperc * 0.01,2))
			+ Round(sum(Round( (SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01),2)) * SL.discperc * 0.01,2)
			+ SL.flatdisc,0),
		misccharges=SL.misccharges,
		grosssale=isnull(sum(SD.looseqty * SD.saleprice),0),
		SaleTax=Round(
			SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * 
				(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
				(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
				SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),
		salereturn=000000000.00,
		cgs = SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.AvgPrice)
	FROM  
		saleledger SL, SaleInvDetail SD, Users	
	WHERE  
		SL.ImpactInventory = 'N' AND 
		SL.date >= :ad_StartDate and  
		SL.date <= :ad_EndDate and   
		SL.salecatcode IN (:aa_catcode) and
		SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode and	
		SL.salesmancode = Users.usercode	
	Group by 
		users.username,
		SL.saleinvcode ,
		SL.flatdisc ,
		SL.discperc,
		SL.misccharges,
		SL.invgstperc1
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		UserName = users.username,  
		InvCount=  0,
		SRCount = COUNT(T.SRinvcode),
		counter=0,
		srcounter=1,
		SaleInvValue =0,
		yu=0,
		discount= 0,
		misccharges=0,
		grosssale=0,
		SaleTax=0,
		salereturn=SUM(T.Srinvvalue),
		cgs = SUM(T.CGS)
	FROM
		Users,
		(select 
			salesmancode=srledger.salesmancode,
			srledger.srinvcode,
			cgs = - SUM((srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty) * srdetail.AvgPrice),
			Srinvvalue=
			/*---------start of salestax------*/
			ROUND(
			SUM( (srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty) * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
			(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * 
			(srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0)
			/*------end of tax--------*/
			+
			Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
			(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * 
			(1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges + 
			srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0)
		
		from srledger, srdetail
		where srledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and  
			srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate and  
			srledger.srcatcode IN (:aa_catcode) and
			srledger.srinvcode=srdetail.srinvcode
		group by 
			srledger.salesmancode,
			srledger.srinvcode,
			srledger.discperc,
			srledger.misccharges,
			srledger.salestax,
			srledger.flatdisc,
			srledger.invgstperc1)  T
	WHERE 
		T.salesmancode = users.usercode
	GROUP BY
		users.username) AS MAIN
Group by 
	MAIN.username
ORDER BY 
	MAIN.username
